description: One canonical record per piece, derived read-only from site/data/j.json, studio/data/review.json, studio/data/notes-versions.json, the Studio DB export (pool, reviews, GRUW) and release/schedule.json (publish_at). Generated output; see tools/poem_record.py. The record is private: it lives under studio/data/ and is never emitted into build_public.py output, because its notes.textual field is the per-poem private factual source dossier.

alt_text.description: Derived alt text per published page image: 'Page <label>' where label strips the leading 'diary' from the page id, exactly as the reader renders it.

batch_status.description: The batch status the tracker consumes; 'skip' when the gruw-policy decision is 'skip'.

exposures.description: Public exposures from the Studio release document; the tracker consumes these.

gruw_filed.description: A GRUW batch filed/registered this piece, or the gruw-policy decision is 'skip'.

lines.description: Number of lines in the reviewed line set.

lines_source.description: 'review' when the piece has a review item (its versions list the reviewed blocks); 'top-version' fallback from j.json when it does not.

author.description: Author-written notes (footnote/endnote/reflection/critical-note) from the Studio notes collection, when present; empty when the collection is absent.

textual.description: Generated transcription-derived notes: uncertain readings as factual-citation, line provenance as research-dossier. This is the private factual source dossier; never published.

pool.description: Exact-value pool from the Studio release document via post_poem.pool_of(); 'unsorted' when no release document exists, 'unknown' for any non-exact value.

publish_at.description: From release/schedule.json; null when unscheduled. The scheduler takes this as input and never invents a cadence.

release_number.description: From the Studio release document (num); null when unnumbered.

sources.description: sha256 of the three source files the record was derived from.

title.description: First line, from the review item; the tracker's title for this piece.

transcript_sha.description: sha256 of the canonical JSON of {id, lines_source, lines:[{lineId, text}]} for the reviewed line set, with review corrections applied.

verified.description: Every line of the reviewed line set is confirmed or corrected in the DB reviews.

versions.description: Version ids from site/data/j.json (notes-versions.json must agree).

title: Per-poem record (journal-handwritten-web #31)
